steps.en: Install the CLI and open it on your project folder
steps.zh: 装好 CLI，指向你的项目文件夹

steps.en: Connect a model: your own API key, or a local endpoint
steps.zh: 接上模型：自己的 API key，或本地端点
steps.code: openscience keys add · openscience local add

steps.en: Describe the research task in plain language, optionally agreeing on method first
steps.zh: 用大白话描述研究任务，可先对齐方法再干

steps.en: The lead agent works the turn step by step: shell, Python/R kernels, files, science connectors
steps.zh: 主 agent 逐步执行：shell、Python/R 内核、文件、科学连接器

steps.en: Approve the risky command or new network host it asks about
steps.zh: 它请求危险命令或新网络主机时，你来批

steps.en: Bounded subtasks run on parallel workers; the lead keeps synthesis and the final say
steps.zh: 有边界的子任务交给并行 worker，综合和结论留在主线

steps.en: The answer lands with the full trace and the files it wrote in your project
steps.zh: 答案连同完整轨迹和写好的文件落回你的项目

value.en: A checkable result on your disk — data, code, figures, report and the trace — not a confident paragraph
value.zh: 落到磁盘的可核查结果——数据、代码、图、报告加执行轨迹，而不是一段自信的文本
